# PhysicsRayCast 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsRayCast:Int32 x1:Float32, y1:Float32, z1:Float32, x2:Float32, y2:Float32, z2:Float32, mask_low:Int32=-1, mask_high:Int32=-1, sensors:Int32=0, world:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x1` | In | Float32 | required | Where the ray starts, x. |
| `y1` | In | Float32 | required | Where the ray starts, y. |
| `z1` | In | Float32 | required | Where the ray starts, z. |
| `x2` | In | Float32 | required | Where the ray ends, x. Bodies behind this point are not hit. |
| `y2` | In | Float32 | required | Where the ray ends, y. |
| `z2` | In | Float32 | required | Where the ray ends, z. |
| `mask_low` | In | Int32 | `-1` | The layers to look at, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask (bit n is layer n). -1 (default) looks at all layers. |
| `mask_high` | In | Int32 | `-1` | The layers 32 to 63, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask. -1 (default) looks at all layers. |
| `sensors` | In | Int32 | `0` | 1 also finds sensors (see `PhysicsSensor`); 0 (default) leaves them out. |
| `world` | In | Int32 | `0` | The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world. |

**Returns:** The entity of the body that was hit, or 0 if there is none.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sends a ray from one point to another through the bodies of a physics world and returns the closest body it hits. All points are in the world. The ray sees bodies where their entities are now, including a body that the program moved since the last `PhysicsUpdate`. It does not see legacy colliders or the meshes of `LinePick`, which are a different world.

What was hit is kept for `GetPhysicsHitEntity`, `GetPhysicsHitX`, `GetPhysicsHitY`, `GetPhysicsHitZ`, `GetPhysicsHitNX`, `GetPhysicsHitNY`, `GetPhysicsHitNZ` and `GetPhysicsHitDistance` until the next ray or point query.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
body = PhysicsRayCast(0, 10, 0, 0, -10, 0)
If body
	Print "Hit at height " + GetPhysicsHitY()
EndIf
```
